name: contextual-ai-bar
title: Contextual AI Bar
description: A narrow dark pill with a music and a sparkle button on the left; the sparkle expands it into a prompt field with a send arrow while four tool icons slide away, and the music button collapses it again.
use: A music or editing app needs a small always-available toolbar that doubles as an AI prompt entry.
avoid: Many tools or long prompts: the pill hides the tools when expanded and only fits one short line.
a11y: The icon buttons have no labels and focus outlines are removed, so the two modes are hard to identify without sight. (keyboard: partial, labels: none, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A slim dark pill on black. Its left end holds a smaller pill with two round icon buttons, a music note and a sparkle, one on a grey active disc. Collapsed, four outline icons are spaced along the right; expanded, a prompt field fills the middle and a round arrow caps the right.
behaves: Clicking the sparkle grows the pill, fades the tool icons out and reveals a focused text input with the send arrow; clicking the music note reverses it. The grey active disc glides between the two leading buttons, and tool icons scale on hover.
customise: Placeholder text, the two leading icons, the tool icon array and the initial expanded state are props; colours, spring and the pill layout are fixed in the source.
weight: light: A few layout springs on one small pill; it is idle between taps.
demo: Placeholder Make the chorus punchier; tools are scissors, sliders, speaker and loop icons.
issues: Focus outlines are removed from the icon buttons, leaving no visible keyboard focus.
polishWhy: Satisfying morph with a tight pill; unlabelled icon buttons and no focus ring are the flaws.
